UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and casting preferences for an authenticated MultiCast user.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the user profile and default device label.

phoneNumber.description: Optional E.164 phone number verified via SMS OTP.

defaultDeviceName.description: Saved device label for rooms created or joined.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

RecentRoom.title: RecentRoom
RecentRoom.description: Recent MultiCast room history entry owned by a specific authenticated user (never stores room PINs or tokens).

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who created or joined the room.

deviceName.description: This user's device name in that room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the history record was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last used.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile documents containing PII, accessible strictly by the owning verified user.

/users/{userId}/recentRooms/{roomId}.description: User-scoped recent rooms subcollection for quick reconnection (excludes PINs and auth tokens).
